parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a project for a 58 m² apartment in Vienna, Austria: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, furnishing and procurement, and a turnkey renovation.
In 58 m², it is important to make use of every meter without losing the sense of open space — hence the attention to the layout, ergonomics, and storage.
The custom furniture was designed alongside the interior, so the wardrobes and storage systems are built into the architecture of the apartment rather than added on top of it.

Before work began, a detailed cost estimate was prepared covering labor, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting. A turnkey renovation of the apartment was then carried out according to the technical documentation.
